'''Carol Wisely''' was Decipher's Vice President of Marketing and the original host of [[Radio Free Decipher]]. She hosted it until episode 30, when Kyle Heuer and Evan Lorentz took over regular hosting.<ref name="rfd-index" />

== Volunteer program ==

Wisely recruited [[Winfried Sommerfeld]] into Decipher's volunteer program after the Essen game fair in October 1996, where he had helped Red Leader [[Jonathan Quesenberry]].<ref name="decsq-sommerfeld" />
